payload.title: stories save-version prints write before saving, so a crash looks like a saved version
payload.description: story_commands.py prints the line ending in 'version N write' before save_story_version runs. When the save then fails, as it did with the missing markusmd, the output contains 'version 2 write' and nothing was saved. docs/story-reporting.md says the write line prints only after the save. stories versions showed only version 1. Fix: print it after the save, or make the first line a plan line.
